adapted.why: Target-only: this manifest, which scripts/check-bff-conformance.mjs reads.
Package name @organization-experience/bff; scripts and dependency versions unchanged.
Forwards /api/v1/* to the Organization Control API's /v1/* instead of Identity Control's: option organizationControlBaseUrl, and its log line and comment.
Environment prefix ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_*; upstream organizationControlBaseUrl from ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_ORGANIZATION_CONTROL_URL; one application, so no developerWebRoot or accountWebRoot.
One application at the root: applicationRoot returns '/' for every path, so routes.ts stays identical and every sign-in asks for aal2. No /developer/ or /account/ prefixes.
Process name organization-experience-bff in its one stderr line and header comment.
Environment prefix ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_* and process name organization-experience-migrate.
Serves one application at / and no Developer Console or account experience; passes organizationControlBaseUrl to the proxy.
Two assertions follow the single application: a sign-in started under /developer/ lands at /?sign-in=*, and every sign-in asks for aal2.

Developer Console and account experience suites replaced by one test that their paths get this application's shell; configuration tests use the ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_* names and organizationControlBaseUrl.
testConfig and startHarness set organizationControlBaseUrl and no developer or account web roots, following Config.
